title: Output is inconsistent: are the rules vague, or are the cases hard?
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Swings only on borderline cases; rules are concrete
Define each level as a checkable test
Many false positives in one category
rule: Clear rules plus wobbly answers means show, don't tell: two to four worked examples at the boundary.

title: Accuracy weak on some layouts: tailor, list, or teach?
head: Situation
Right mechanism
Why
rows: Varied layouts, new ones keep arriving
Small, fixed set of known vendors
Measure by doc type and field
rule: Pick few-shot examples from where the model fails, showing varied structures and how fields were found.

title: Instructions give inconsistent results: rules or examples?
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Intent hard to state as rules
Closed, fully known set of conditions
Explicit criteria or a decision table
Too many false positives from vague wording
Model must flag what it cannot decide
Enum with "unclear" plus a detail field
rule: When cases turn on judgement and new variants will appear, use 2–4 worked examples that show the reasoning.

title: Conventions not followed: are they missing, or just described poorly?
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Convention ignored, and /memory doesn't list its file
Fix the home: project CLAUDE.md or .claude/rules/
Rules are vague about what counts
Data arrives in mixed fixed formats
rule: First check the rules load (/memory). If they do and output still varies, add a few concrete examples.

title: Many layouts: do you know them in advance?
head: Situation
Right mechanism
Why
rows: Few, stable vendors with known quirks
Unclear what counts as the value
rule: Few-shot examples chosen for structural variety generalise to unseen layouts. Per-case notes grow with every case and do nothing on day one.

title: Output still inconsistent: what has already been tried?
head: Situation
Next step
Why
rows: Detailed rules work on simple cases, ambiguous combinations still vary
Examples generalise to cases the rules don't cover
Explicit criteria or a decision table
rule: When detailed instructions stop improving consistency, show 2–4 worked examples with the reasoning.

title: Structured output is wrong: shape or content?
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Fields present, content inconsistent despite instructions
Content wrong in a detectable way
Validate and retry with the specific error
Errors only a fresh reader would catch
rule: A schema fixes shape; samples fix content. When instructions exist but output still varies, add 2–4 complete examples.

title: Extraction varies on hard cases: what fixes it?
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Schema fits, definitions exist, hard cases vary
Validate and retry with the error
One prompt doing several unrelated jobs
rule: When the schema fits and definitions exist but tricky cases still vary, show 2–4 worked cases with the reasoning.

title: Output inconsistent? Ask whether the rules are loading
head: What you observe
Where the fault is
Fix
rows: Rules loaded, output varies on hard cases
Generated code has bugs a fresh eye would spot
rule: Instructions loaded but output inconsistent → a few concrete examples covering the hard cases.

title: Rule clear but misapplied: what do you add to the prompt?
head: Situation
Best addition
Why
rows: No clear rule for the category
Clear rule; instances take new, varied forms
Clear rule; instances are a small fixed set
rule: When instances of a rule keep changing form, show varied examples with reasoning; enumerate only stable sets.

title: Extraction weak on some documents: what's missing?
head: What you observe
Gap
Fix
rows: Descriptions detailed; errors on varied layouts
One prompt covers very different document types
Value not printed in the document
Errors only on certain doc types
rule: Clear descriptions but varied layouts → add worked examples that span the layouts.
